title: One shell starts a program thirty times, slowly
threat_model: An attacker's script starts the same number of programs but spreads them over time to stay under a rate threshold.
known_gap: rapid_spawn counts distinct children of one parent inside a sliding window of WINDOW_NS (2 s). Thirty spawns spread over about 24 seconds never put the threshold's worth of children inside one window.
notes: One bash runs /bin/true and then sleep, COUNT (30) times, SPACING (0.8) seconds apart. Both are set at the top of action.sh, and a unit test checks that the children started inside one window, counting the true and the sleep of each pass, stay below SPAWN_THRESHOLD.
